title: Cost and price fields are hidden from a user without financial access
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (Admin, [User-B]) · 2 browsers · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: an Admin, who has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • [Loc-1] = the location you work in (pick it in the location switcher in the top bar).
  • [User-B]: a custom role with 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete' on and See Financial Data OFF.
  • Data at [Loc-1]: one tracked part [Part-A].

Setup

  1. Write down: [Part-A] = ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOFIN-01 (example).
  2. Sign in as the Admin and pick [Loc-1] in the location switcher in the top bar.
  3. At [Loc-1]: Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part → Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL No Fin → Part Number: [Part-A] → Category: any (e.g. Uncategorized) → Cost: 10.00 → Sell Price: 20.00 → keep the default bin row (Quantity e.g. 3) → Save.
  4. Settings → Roles & Permissions → Create custom role → name it ZZAUTOTEST PL NOFIN ROLE → turn on the Parts department and 'Part Library & Inventory' View, Create & Edit and Delete → See Financial Data OFF → Save.
  5. Settings → Staff → add a staff member (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL User B, with an e-mail you can open) → Role: ZZAUTOTEST PL NOFIN ROLE → give access to [Loc-1] → Save → accept the invitation e-mail and set a password. [User-B] = that staff member.
  6. Open a second browser (or a private window) and sign in there as [User-B], at [Loc-1].
  7. Check the setup worked: as [User-B], Parts → Inventory opens and search [Part-A] shows the row.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin: click the [Part-A] row.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. As [User-B]: click the [Part-A] row.
  4. Turn the switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off.
  5. Turn it back on.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. As [User-B]: click New Inventory Part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Admin sees Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge.
  • Step 3: [User-B] sees no Average Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field.
  • Step 4: Min and Max disappear.
  • Step 5: Min and Max show again.
  • Step 7: [User-B] sees no Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field in New Inventory Part.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S13-R4a, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 1.6 (Branch: a new part with tracking off), board 5.2 (Switch off). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R4a: “Vendor is hidden where the screen that opens the dialog hides it. Cost, Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge show only to a user who can see financial data. Min and Max show only while tracking is on (S4-R5).”
